## Reproducibility

```{r reproducibility}
# The short hash of the commit this report was rendered from, so a reader can
# check out exactly the code that produced these numbers.
commit <- tryCatch(
  suppressWarnings(system("git rev-parse --short HEAD", intern = TRUE)),
  error = function(e) character(0)
)
if (length(commit) == 0) commit <- "unknown (not a git repository, or no commits yet)"

```

This report was rendered on `r format(Sys.Date(), "%Y-%m-%d")` from commit
`r commit` by running `code/run_all.R`. Package versions are recorded in

are logged in [`../docs/decisions.md`](../docs/decisions.md).
